rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act: no criminal record inquiries before conditional offer
rules.requirement: A housing provider may not require an application that asks about criminal record, or make any oral or written inquiry about criminal record, before making a conditional offer. Narrow exceptions apply for methamphetamine manufacture convictions in federally assisted housing and lifetime sex offender registration.
rules.key_value: No criminal record inquiry before conditional offer

rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act: criminal records that may never be considered
rules.requirement: Before or after a conditional offer, a housing provider may not evaluate an applicant based on non-conviction arrests or charges, expunged, pardoned, vacated or sealed records, or juvenile adjudications.

rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act: limited convictions and lookback periods after conditional offer
rules.requirement: After a conditional offer, a housing provider may consider only convictions for listed serious offenses or lifetime sex offender registration offenses. It may also consider first-degree indictable offenses within 6 years, second- or third-degree within 4 years, and fourth-degree within 1 year.

rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act: withdrawal of conditional offer, individualized assessment and notice
rules.requirement: A housing provider may withdraw a conditional offer based on criminal record only if it determines by a preponderance of the evidence that withdrawal is necessary to fulfill a substantial, legitimate, nondiscriminatory interest. It must do an individualized assessment and give written reasons with an opportunity to appeal. The applicant may request, within 30 days, the information relied on, which must be provided free within 10 days.
rules.key_value: Written notice with specific reasons; applicant records request within 30 days; provider responds within 10 days

rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act: written disclosure of criminal history review before accepting application fee
rules.requirement: Before accepting any application fee, a housing provider must disclose in writing whether its eligibility criteria include review of criminal history, and that the applicant may provide evidence of inaccuracies, rehabilitation or mitigating factors.

rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act: ban on advertisements excluding applicants with criminal records
rules.requirement: A housing provider may not publish advertisements or use applications or statements that expressly exclude applicants who have been arrested or convicted, or that express unlawful limitations on criminal record, except as permitted by the act. It also may not disseminate or misuse an applicant's criminal record.

rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act: no drug or alcohol testing or treatment records of applicants
rules.requirement: A housing provider may not require an applicant to submit to a drug or alcohol test, or request consent to obtain information from a drug abuse treatment facility.
